title: Initial vibration direction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that particle P begins vibrating downward when the wave reaches it.

title: Second crest arrival time
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate and provide the correct numerical answer of 1.9 seconds for when P reaches the wave crest for the second time.

title: Wave propagation understanding
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding that particles begin vibrating in the same direction as the adjacent particle that first disturbed them.

title: Crest position calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the distance the second crest travels to reach P, accounting for the initial wave position at Q.

title: Time-distance-speed relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the formula t = s/v correctly to find the time for the crest to travel the calculated distance.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units (meters and seconds) throughout their calculations.

title: Incorrect vibration direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly states the initial vibration direction as upward or horizontal.

title: First crest confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student calculates the time for the first crest to reach P instead of the second crest.
